column1: # WHO AM I — the others can see it, you can't. Ask yes/no questions.
# Format: IDENTITY<tab>difficulty  (no decoy — that is a RINGER mechanic)
# Everything here must be answerable with yes/no questions by a table anywhere
# in the world. That rules out named celebrities and national figures, which are
# the usual filler in this genre and are regional almost by definition — famous
# in one country, blank stares in the next. Roles, archetypes and animals are
# universal, and they narrow down cleanly: alive? human? do you work indoors?
